The Minutes of a Called Meeting of the City Council
Austin, Tex, August 03, 1892.
Hon. John Mc Donald, mayor, presiding
Roll Call. Present - Aldermen Graham, Linn, Morris, Newton, Nitschke, North, Platt,
Schuler, Shelley, Meyerman - 10.
Absent - Aldermen Anderson, Assmann, Glass, Hume, Jackson, Ketchum, Miller, Schneider,
Suter, Townsend, Warmoth, Giller - 12.
A call of the Council was moved and duly adopted and the Marshal sent after the absentees.
It was moved that the Council take a recess of five minutes. Carried.
After Expiration of recess the Roll of the Council was on motion suspended and the roll
again called, which resulted as follows: Present - Aldermen Glass, Graham, Jackson, Linn,
Morris, Newton, Nitschke, North, Platt, Schulen, Shelley, Meyerman - 12.
Absent - Aldermen Anderson, Assmann, Hume, Ketchum, Miller, Schneider, Suter, Townsend,
Warmoth, Giller - 10.
The following was read:
Mayor's Office,
Austin, Tex, August 3 1892.
To the Members of the Board of Aldermen of the City of Austin: Gentlemen:- I hereby Call a
special meeting of the City Council of the City of Austin to assemble in the Council
Chamber at the City Hall at 5 o'clock p. m. this day, August 3d, 1892, for the purpose of
considering the question of repairing the bridge known as the Bouldin Creek bridge and to
appoint a Committee to Confer with the Hon. Commissioners Court of Travis County, Texas,
Concerning said repairs.
John Mc Donald, Mayor.

1, P.M. Austin, Texas, August 3, 1892.
I hereby certify that Aldermen Anderson, Assmann, Glass, Graham, Hume, Jackson, Linn,
Miller, Morris, Newton, Nitschke, North, Platt, Schneider, Schulen, Shelley, Suter,
Townsend, Warmoth, Meyerman and Giller have each been served with a copy of the above
[illegible] by reading it to them in person, and that Alderman Ketchum has been served by
leaving a [illegible] copy of the [illegible] at his place of business.
M. Platt,
Police Officer.
The Mayor presented the following
Hon. John McDonald, Mayor of the City of Austin: I am herein [illegible] to upon
Communication of


 --- Page break --- 

368

July, 28th, in reference to the condition of the bridge over Beuldin's Creek on the San
Antonio road, we beg leave to invite yourself and a Committee of the City Council to meet
with this Court and decide what can be done in the premises for the preservation of the
property referred to.
To that End we will call a special meeting at any day set by you, or meet you during our
regular Session next week.

Very Respectfully,

Jno. W. Brown,
President of the Board.

Bouldin Bridge
repairs.
Committee to
Confer with Co.
Comrs.

Alderman Schuler moved that a Committee of three be appointed to confer with the
Commissioners' Court of Travis County Texas, with reference to repairing what is commonly
known as the Bouldin Creek bridge and to report the result of
Such Conference to the City Council.
Aldermen Miller, Warmoth and Anderson Entered the
Council and answered to their names.
The motion made by Alderman Schuler was then adopted and the Chair appointed Aldermen
Schuler, Nitschke and Wayerman as Such Committee
The Council then adjourned.
Milton Morris,
City Clerk.
